episodes.name: Fat Gun
episodes.overview: This "Top Gun" parody chronicles Peter/Maverick getting together with Lois/Charlie, the tragic death of Joe/Goose, and Peter/Maverick's blooming relationship with Chris/Rooster.

episodes.name: Live, Laugh, Love
episodes.overview: When Peter realizes Joe has never found him funny, he is determined to make Joe laugh; Lois chaperones Chris and Meg's school trip, where she strives to reunite the principal with his long-lost love.

episodes.name: Drunk with Power
episodes.overview: Peter swaps lives with Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh and is forced to make a ruling on the constitutionality of gay marriage, meanwhile, Brett tries to become friends with Quagmire, Cleveland and Joe.

episodes.name: Lois C.K.
episodes.overview: Lois becomes a stand-up comic, using real life stories about Peter as content; Peter tries his best to straighten his life out to avoid being ridiculed by Lois's act.

episodes.name: The Chicken or the Meg
episodes.overview: Meg starts dating a chicken she meets on a reality dating show.

episodes.name: Dog Is My Co-Pilot
episodes.overview: After successfully landing a plane, Brian and Quagmire go on a press tour. Meanwhile Chris and Stewie open a boutique pizza place.

episodes.name: Pitch Imperfect
episodes.overview: Peter must gain his family's respect back after he makes a humiliating throw. Brian and Stewie become chiropractors.

episodes.name: Hard Times at Adam West High
episodes.overview: Chris uses Stewie's time machine to stop himself from having an erection during a book report. Peter becomes jealous when he sits out of a lottery pool and the guys win.

episodes.name: The Elle Word
episodes.overview: When Quagmire starts dating a mystery woman, Peter, Joe and Cleveland go on a stakeout and discover her to be the librarian.

episodes.name: A Real Who's Hulu
episodes.overview: The Griffins spoof "Only Murders in the Building," "The Dropout," and "The Bear."

episodes.name: China Doll
episodes.overview: When Stewie sees a tag on Rupert reading "Made in China," he heads off to China to meet Rupert's family.

episodes.name: One Foot in Front of the Mother
episodes.overview: Due to a police complaint about his excessive barking, Brian has to wear a shock collar; looking to join an after-school team, Chris discovers a talent for speed walking.

episodes.name: The Fat Lotus
episodes.overview: In this Griffin-family twist on the popular HBO series, Peter suspects Lois of betraying his trust with Quagmire at a swanky vacation, while Stewie worries that his wealthy new friends plan to sacrifice him in a volcano.

episodes.name: Cool Hand Lois
episodes.overview: Lois embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

episodes.name: Martian Meg
episodes.overview: Fed up with feeling like she doesn't belong, Meg enlists in a training program for a mission to Mars.

episodes.name: Row v. Wade
episodes.overview: Brian wins a boat on "The Price is Right" and decides to sail to Texas to help women seeking legal abortions.

episodes.name: Karenheit 451
episodes.overview: Lois becomes the leader of a group of mothers who want to ban books from schools.

episodes.name: Twain's World
episodes.overview: In an effort to improve his writing, Brian convinces Stewie to go back in time and bring Mark Twain to the present day, but the plan goes awry when Twain overindulges in pornography.
